work_completed: Corrected protocol focus from only local non-MCP runtime protocols to third-party interoperability protocols.
Added third-party protocol profiles for A2A, ACP, AG-UI, OpenAPI/REST, NLIP/Open Floor watchlist, and explicit MCP exclusion.
Added docs/third-party-protocols.md and updated README, skill docs, and package files.
decisions_made: Prioritized A2A as the primary agent-to-agent target.
Prioritized AG-UI as the primary agent-to-user/frontend target.
Classified ACP as a REST-native compatibility adapter because ACP documentation says it is now part of A2A.
Kept MCP excluded from the core harness.
decisions_pending: Joshua can decide whether the next implementation should be an A2A Agent Card generator or a full A2A HTTP adapter.
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: The repo currently has a third-party protocol registry and documentation, not live network adapters. Next practical step is an A2A adapter module that generates an Agent Card from .otoi/protocol metadata and maps governed Pi runs to A2A task lifecycle.
